contea di ritrovamento: County of Herefordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy (or bronze) nummus of Constans (337 -350 AD) minted between 348 and 350 AD. The obverse depicts a likeness of Constans showing a draped bust facing right with diademed crown. The obverse inscription reads: [DN C]ONST - ANS PF [AVG]. The reverse depicts a phoenix facing right on globe. The inscription reads: [F]EL TEM[P REPARATIO] - (The return of happy times).
